description: Construction of the Central Expressway Project Section IV (from Kurunegala to Dambulla)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- In order to realize the full expected benefits of the entire Central Expressway, it is essential to implement Section IV from Kurunegala to Dambulla, which has a total length of 58.6 km. The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2025-06-09, has granted approval to acquire lands identified for the construction of the said section. The physical progress of the land acquisition process is 73.3%, and compensations payments for land acquisitions are required to be made further. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways and Urban Development to take the following actions to expedite the construction of the Central Expressway Project Section IV (from Kurunegala to Dambulla), was approved by the Cabinet:

to identify the appropriate source of funds for the implementation of that section by the Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development and allocate the necessary provisions accordingly.


to have the preliminary geotechnical investigations, slope stabilization and landslide risk assessments carried out through the National Building Research Organization, prior to commencing construction, since the said section runs through geotechnically sensitive areas.


to have the hydraulic designs, flood risk assessment and storm water management planning carried out through the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation, since that section runs through several major and minor waterways.
